subject: CAIQ evidence chain & partner validation play
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@firmitas.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Firmitas Compliance <regulatory@firmitas.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ - evidence chain & control lineage for partner onboarding

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As we move toward a formal review with our security committee next Tuesday, could you provide a CAIQ-aligned mapping that shows not just the control responses but the evidence chain (who owns each artifact, where it lives, and an immutable link or snapshot)?

Specific asks:
- A single worksheet mapping CAIQ control IDs to Redwood responses and the exact artifact name(s).
- A short chain-of-custody note per artifact (owner, retention window, storage location).
- Any live-sample snippets for runtime telemetry (logs or traces) we can include in our packet (redacted as needed).

We have an internal template but if Redwood has a preferred format that makes QA simpler, happy to adopt.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Liu
Security & Compliance Manager, Firmitas
regulatory@firmitas.com

Attachments: firmitas-caiq-template.xlsx (referenced)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@firmitas.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ - evidence chain & control lineage for partner onboarding

Hi Sara —

Appreciate the clear ask. We'll produce a CAIQ crosswalk that includes a control -> answer -> artifact row and add brief chain-of-custody notes for each artifact. Plan:

1) Deliver draft mapping (worksheet + narrative) by EOD Fri (7/23).
2) Provide a small redacted telemetry sample and an S3 log snippet for runtime evidence.
3) Assign owners for each artifact so your reviewers can follow up directly.

Marissa and Jonas are looping in to help assemble artifacts and confirm retention/residency details.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Trust & Safety | Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwood.com

Attachments: none

- I'll work the configuration/keystore and deployment docs (S3 buckets, KMS reference, private deploy notes).
- Jonas, can you confirm telemetry retention and a sanitized log snippet we can share? I will attach the mapping workbook once populated.

Subject: Re: CAIQ - evidence chain & control lineage for partner onboarding

Marissa —

Confirmed. Retention windows: runtime telemetry (30 days default in hosted), audit logs (365 days archival to Glacier-equivalent), and KV metadata (90 days). I'll extract a 1MB redacted log sample and a 3-line telemetry trace showing request routing and kernel selection. I'll upload the S3 snippet and put a pointer into the workbook.

Also adding a short note on our keystore rotation cadence (30/180 day options) for their reviewers.

Jonas Weber
Principal Infra Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachments: s3_log_snip.txt (to be uploaded)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@firmitas.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ evidence chain & mapping — draft delivered

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the patience. Attached is our draft packet for your review:
- caiaq_control_map_v3.xlsx (tabbed: control-responses, artifact-index, owner-contacts)
- evidence_chain_template.docx (narrative chain-of-custody per artifact)
- s3_log_snip.txt (redacted runtime log snippet)

Key highlights:
- Every control row includes the artifact name, file path (internal drive/S3 pointer), owner (email), time window, and an evidence snapshot id.
- We included a 'residency note' column clarifying hosted vs. private deploy implications.
- For telemetry, we provided a redacted sample and a short explanation of our batching/caching behavior that explains how KV-caches are traced.

Next steps: please let us know any follow-ups your security reviewers ask for. If useful, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with the artifacts owners (Jonas for telemetry/audit logs; Marissa for config/keystore).

Best,
Evelyn

Attachments: caiaq_control_map_v3.xlsx, evidence_chain_template.docx, s3_log_snip.txt
